Explore Williamstown New To You: Pre-loved Clothing Market

New To You: Pre-loved Clothing Market

By New To You Markets

Twice a year (Biannual) Williamstown, VIC
Get directions

About this market

Welcome to New To You Markets: Your Go-To Destination for Pre-Loved Fashion! Embrace Bargains, Unique Styles, Sustainability, and Community All Under One Roof! At New To You Markets, we’re all about sharing the love of pre-loved clothing and accessories, shopping for bargains, never paying retail, making some cash, creating our own style, encouraging the recycling and reuse of clothing, having fun, and community. We are a pre-loved clothing and accessories market. We welcome any type of clothing stall; be it contemporary fashion, vintage, retro, designer, A+ or anything else in between. Our markets are not style, size or age-specific (except no kids or baby clothing). All our markets are indoors. Our venues are carefully selected for ease of use, accessibility by public transport, and close to points of interest.

Where to find us

New To You: Pre-loved Clothing Market 104 Ferguson Street, Williamstown, VIC, 3016
